diagnostics.message: google_alloydb_user.users only references google_alloydb_cluster.primary (cluster = google_alloydb_cluster.primary.id), and google_alloydb_instance.primary depends on that same cluster, so users and the primary instance are unordered siblings. A google_alloydb_user can only be created once the cluster has a running primary instance (the provider's own examples for this resource always set depends_on = [google_alloydb_instance.<primary>]), so creating the users can race instance provisioning and fail with the cluster not yet able to accept users. Add depends_on = [google_alloydb_instance.primary] to the users resource.
